exposure: Hematoma of a cesarean section wound
outcome: Incisional surgical site infection following cesarean section
cohort: All women who underwent cesarean section between 2005 and 2016 in Ireland
finding: Hematoma of the cesarean section wound was the strongest risk factor for incisional surgical site infection, while other significant risk factors included public healthcare, maternal age over 35 years, pre-existing diabetes, and urinary tract infection in pregnancy.
